reason: Lemma: no Borel probability on P^1(R) is invariant under two unipotents with distinct fixed lines, in particular u_+ and u_- (Breuillard Exercises Sec. 2 III.5, read in the fetched full text). Proof: in a basis adapted to the fixed lines the unipotents are I+cE_12 and I+c'E_21, acting as t -> t+c (fixing infinity) and s -> s+c' in the charts t=x/y and s=y/x; invariance under the first forces nu = delta_infinity because the sets [kc,(k+1)c) partition R with equal mass, and the second unipotent moves infinity.
